# Code of Conduct / 行为准则

## Our pledge / 我们的承诺

We want `dsh-agent-plugins-market` to be a welcoming, respectful, and constructive project for everyone, regardless of background, identity, experience, or language. Contributors, maintainers, reviewers, and users are expected to participate in good faith.

我们希望 `dsh-agent-plugins-market` 成为一个友善、尊重且有建设性的项目，不因背景、身份、经验或语言而区别对待。贡献者、维护者、审查者和用户都应本着善意参与。

This project follows the spirit of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), adapted for this repository.

本项目遵循并结合本仓库实际情况采用 [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) 的精神。

## Expected behavior / 建议行为

- Be respectful, patient, and specific when giving feedback.
- Assume good intent while addressing impact and evidence.
- Welcome different viewpoints and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
- Keep discussions focused on the project and make space for quieter participants.
- Protect private information, credentials, and security reports.

- 提供反馈时保持尊重、耐心和具体。
- 在关注实际影响和证据的同时，默认他人出于善意。
- 欢迎不同观点，并清晰解释技术权衡。
- 让讨论聚焦项目，也为不常发言的参与者留出空间。
- 保护隐私信息、凭据和安全报告。

## Unacceptable behavior / 不可接受行为

- Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, threats, or personal attacks.
- Hate speech, sexualized attention, or deliberately humiliating content.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Deliberately disrupting discussions, reviews, issue tracking, or automation.
- Submitting malicious code, concealed credentials, or intentionally misleading reports.
- Retaliating against someone who makes a good-faith report.

- 骚扰、歧视、恐吓、威胁或人身攻击。
- 仇恨言论、性化骚扰或故意羞辱他人的内容。
- 未经许可公开他人的私人信息。
- 故意扰乱讨论、审查、issue 跟踪或自动化流程。
- 提交恶意代码、隐藏凭据或故意误导性的报告。
- 报复善意提出问题或报告的人。

## Scope / 适用范围

This code applies in project spaces, including GitHub issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, commits, and project-related private communication. It also applies when a participant is representing the project in another public space.

本准则适用于项目空间，包括 GitHub issue、PR、审查、讨论、提交记录和与项目相关的私下沟通；当参与者在其他公开场合代表本项目时同样适用。

## Reporting / 报告方式

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, contact the project maintainer privately through [@Sivan757 on GitHub](https://github.com/Sivan757). Do not create a public issue containing personal information or an unpatched security vulnerability. Include the relevant links, approximate time, and any evidence that can be shared safely.

如果你经历或看到不可接受的行为，请通过 GitHub 私下联系项目维护者 [@Sivan757](https://github.com/Sivan757)。不要创建包含个人信息或未修复安全漏洞的公开 issue。请提供相关链接、大致时间，以及可以安全分享的证据。

Security vulnerabilities must follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and should be submitted through the private security-advisory channel rather than the conduct-report channel.

安全漏洞必须遵循 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)，应通过 GitHub 私密安全公告渠道提交，而不是通过行为准则报告渠道提交。

## Enforcement / 执行

The maintainers will review reports as promptly and fairly as possible, protect reporter confidentiality where practical, and avoid conflicts of interest. Depending on severity and context, responses may include a private warning, content removal, a temporary restriction, or a permanent ban from project spaces. A report made in good faith will not result in retaliation.

维护者会尽可能及时、公平地处理报告，并在可行范围内保护报告者隐私、避免利益冲突。根据严重程度和具体情况，处理措施可能包括私下提醒、移除内容、临时限制参与或永久禁止参与项目空间。善意报告不会招致报复。

Maintainers may clarify or update this document as the project evolves. Questions about this code of conduct can be directed to the maintainer privately.

项目发展过程中，维护者可能澄清或更新本文件。对本行为准则有疑问时，可私下向维护者咨询。
